scope: Three materially different questions were checked against primary literature and existing local assets. These are candidate qualification screens, not three failed experiments.
decision: No new candidate in this screen qualifies for a decisive low-cost pilot with the currently established interfaces, evidence and local resources.

activity.performed: Read existing local files and primary web sources; write this summary only.
activity.excluded: Any separately recorded GRASP engineering cost measurement and all historical experiments cited as resource evidence.

candidates.scientific_question: Does access to action-conditioned world forecasts reveal training-trajectory membership beyond information available from the public observation/action sequence or an ordinary observation encoder?
candidates.proposed_restricted_threat_model: A remote caller can query a fixed pretrained forecast interface for supplied observation/action histories. It cannot read private training records, change weights, relabel examples or alter the victim environment. This threat was not exercised.
candidates.difference_from_archived_routes: Training-experience confidentiality rather than private-goal leakage through online planning queries, truthful source adaptation, replay-priority manipulation or factual/imagined memory writeback.

existing_prior_art.title: Membership Inference Attacks Against Temporally Correlated Data in Deep Reinforcement Learning
existing_prior_art.relevance: Direct prior work already studies trajectory membership in DRL, temporal correlation, and individual versus collective attacks. Merely applying a trajectory classifier to a world model does not identify a new mechanism.

existing_prior_art.title: Real-World Benchmarks Make Membership Inference Attacks Fail on Diffusion Models
existing_prior_art.relevance: CopyMark demonstrates that realistic pretrained-model and unbiased-data evaluation can remove optimistic membership-inference results. Freshly collected nonmembers versus archived demonstrations would confound membership with data-collection distributions.

local_evidence.finding: Existing pretrained weights and some competent task carriers are recorded. This inventory does not establish trajectory-level membership labels for those checkpoints.
An older private-goal query-leakage route is separately archived; it is not evidence for training-data confidentiality.
Official data are linked; MetaWorld is described as 42 tasks with 100 episodes each. The README description alone is not an exact training-membership manifest for a released checkpoint.
The local dataset provenance identifies lerobot/libero_10_image and downloaded files. It does not certify checkpoint-specific member or nonmember status.

local_evidence.anchor: bounded inventory lookup together with data/ file listing
local_evidence.finding: No qualified same-distribution member/nonmember panel tied to the relevant checkpoint was found in this bounded inspection. This is not proof that no such data exist elsewhere.

resource_leads.limitation: No data downloaded, exact released-checkpoint training split verified, or membership panel qualified in this screen.

qualification_failures: The generic temporal trajectory-membership phenomenon has direct prior art; a forecast-interface-specific information increment has not been established.
Exact member labels and a matched same-distribution nonmember cohort are unqualified for the inspected local checkpoints.
Using new simulator traces as nonmembers against stored demonstrations could test collection-policy or state-distribution differences instead of membership.
A newly trained toy or heavily adapted model would not answer the intended question about the existing released pretrained model.
candidates.decision: No-Go for a new pilot under the currently qualified resources.
candidates.reopening_requirement: A verified checkpoint-specific member manifest and a matched independent nonmember panel, plus a prespecified forecast-interface-specific hypothesis distinguishable from standard trajectory membership inference. Evaluation would need trajectory-level splits, model-free and encoder-only controls, standard membership baselines and low-FPR reporting.

candidates.scientific_question: Can a third party submit a policy that receives a better world-model evaluation score and deployment eligibility while producing worse independently measured real-environment utility?
candidates.proposed_restricted_threat_model: The third party may submit or optimize its policy but cannot modify the evaluator, initial-state distribution, reward specification or real environment. The contemplated evaluator remains fixed. No policy submission or optimization was executed.
candidates.difference_from_archived_routes: Evaluation and deployment qualification integrity, rather than modifying the world-model checkpoint, Goal branch, uncertainty input or factual-memory state.

existing_prior_art.title: Imperfect World Models are Exploitable
existing_prior_art.relevance: Defines model exploitation through a reversal of policy preference between a learned transition model and the real environment. Ordinary score-versus-utility ranking reversal is therefore already a directly studied phenomenon.
existing_prior_art.limits: The paper's finite-MDP and relaxed safe-horizon results are cited as prior art; this screen did not independently verify all theorem proofs or establish their assumptions for the local neural model.

existing_prior_art.title: Theoretical Foundations and Effective Algorithms for Policy-Aware Simulator Learning
existing_prior_art.relevance: Studies policy-aware simulator learning and minimax simulator/policy relationships. A generic adversarial policy-versus-simulator setup is not enough to distinguish the proposed contribution.

existing_prior_art.title: False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems
existing_prior_art.relevance: Directly studies world-model security in agentic text settings, including prompt-based exploitation. Switching to a textual evaluator does not by itself establish a new security mechanism.

local_evidence.finding: The previous native interface audit did not establish an externally writable policy/candidate-submission boundary for native N2 selection. Adding arbitrary candidate replacement would be a separately specified system.

The released Value target concerns discounted behavior-policy return rather than a calibrated probability of task success. A high Value score cannot be relabeled as a validated deployment safety certificate.

Historical analysis already includes 60 real first-candidate continuations. The native ranking showed no aggregate success advantage over the fixed-candidate comparisons in that panel; this existing result cannot be promoted into a new evaluator attack.

local_evidence.anchor: existing local carrier inventory; bounded models/ and vendor/ name search by the screening agent
local_evidence.finding: No qualified local WorldEval, dWorldEval or WorldGym asset/runtime was located in the bounded inspection. This is not proof that no public implementation or remote resource exists.

resource_leads.name: WorldEval
resource_leads.limitation: Repository exists, but no locally qualified matched evaluator/checkpoint/runtime and independent true-utility task panel were established here. No assets downloaded.

qualification_failures: The generic model-score preference reversal is directly covered by prior work; no distinct causal mechanism beyond evaluator/model exploitation was identified.
The currently competent local Cosmos path lacks a demonstrated external policy-submission or candidate-replacement interface under the proposed restricted permissions.
The local Value output is not a calibrated success or safety certification score.
Existing genuine candidate replay already constrains the utility story; selecting a favorable subset or repeating ranking tests without a new mechanism would not produce independent evidence.
The alternative public evaluator leads are not qualified low-cost local carriers.
candidates.decision: No-Go for a new pilot in this screen; the broad evaluator-security problem remains open.
candidates.reopening_requirement: A distinct mechanism and an explicit supported external policy-evaluation boundary, with an appropriate score contract, competent fixed evaluator and independent real consequences. Ordinary ranking reversal, a generic filter or a seed search is insufficient.

candidates.scientific_question: When a sensor is legitimately marked unavailable, does a world model promote generated completion into independent observed evidence and thereby make overconfident unsafe decisions?
candidates.proposed_restricted_threat_model: An adversary can affect only one sensor's availability. It cannot edit the remaining observations, task goal, model weights or executed actions. This threat was not exercised.
candidates.difference_from_archived_routes: Missing-observation provenance and evidential double counting, rather than arbitrary image/proprio slot replacement, goal changes, uncertainty expansion or an imagined-state cache writer.

existing_prior_art.title: Are Multimodal Transformers Robust to Missing Modality?
existing_prior_art.relevance: Missing-modality sensitivity and dependence on fusion architecture were already studied at CVPR 2022. Generic degradation after deleting a modality is not by itself a new mechanism.

existing_prior_art.title: How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints?
existing_prior_art.relevance: The latest version distinguishes estimation and prediction gaps and studies multimodal privileged supervision and conformal mitigation. It is close prior art for safety-relevant missing information, not evidence that the proposed provenance pathway exists in the local carrier.

local_evidence.finding: Historical native N2 evaluation completed 30 episodes with 29 successes. This is existing carrier competence, not a new run or missing-sensor security result.
The inspected adapter reads wrist and primary images plus proprioception in fixed slots; no sensor-availability or completion-provenance argument is present.
Verified inference accepts fixed conditioning-prefix lengths 4, 5 or 8 for policy, forecast and value. These prefixes are not semantic sensor-missingness flags.
The condition mask identifies a fixed clean prefix from gt_frames; it is not an observed-versus-imputed sensor provenance mask.

The native best-of-N call freshly encodes real observations and generates action/future/value candidates. No missing-camera completion-to-factual-input writeback pathway is present in this inspected call.

resource_leads.name: MultiSafe
resource_leads.observed: The project page still labels its code link 'Code [coming soon]'. Root and this report's writer both checked the page.
resource_leads.limitation: No local matched checkpoint, simulator, data or clean task reproduction qualified. Do not treat this lead as an available experiment carrier.

qualification_failures: The qualified local Cosmos carrier has no demonstrated legal sensor-unavailable interface or completion-provenance consumer needed for this precise hypothesis.
Replacing arbitrary latent/image/proprio slots would change the threat model and revert to ordinary input tampering or already archived modality interventions.
The broader partial-observability and missing-modality safety problem has close existing work; no distinct local evidential-double-counting mechanism was established.
MultiSafe is a relevant primary literature/resource lead, but its currently linked code status does not supply a qualified low-cost local test.
candidates.decision: No-Go for this operation on the inspected carrier; no blanket claim about all multimodal world models.
candidates.reopening_requirement: A concrete native missing-sensor/completion interface and competent matched carrier where generated completion is consumed as evidence, with a hypothesis distinct from ordinary missing-input robustness. Merely selecting another seed or adding a generic filter would not establish it.

interpretation: No-Go here means do not start the proposed pilot from the inspected resources and interface assumptions; it does not empirically falsify the broad scientific question.
Historical clean success is a carrier qualification fact, not a new experiment in this screen and not a security harm signal.
A paper/project resource lead is not evidence that matched checkpoints, data, runtime and task capability are qualified locally.
Ordinary input corruption, filtering, changing seeds or weakening controls is not a replacement novel mechanism.
No attack success rate, new task utility, causal harm result, statistical significance or novelty score was measured.
